title: Vocation Excellence Award
summary: Dr. Priya Rajwade is an accomplished educationist and an inspiring school leader, currently serving as the Principal of Podar International School, Powai.
description:
Dr. Priya Rajwade is an accomplished educationist and an inspiring school leader, currently serving as the Principal of Podar International School, Powai. With over 25 years of experience in teaching and 14 years in educational administration, she has dedicated her career to nurturing young minds and shaping the future of education.

Her impressive academic credentials include an M.Sc., B.Ed., M.A. in Education and a Ph.D., complemented by a leadership programme at XLRI. A strong advocate of holistic and value-based education, Dr. Rajwade believes in fostering empathy, integrity, creativity and responsibility among students, while preparing them to become confident, globally aware citizens rooted in strong cultural values.
